name: Knock
description: Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access. A loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target as its locks give way.
effect: Locks give way at a touch: +10 Thieving for 30 minutes.
notes: Out of combat: +10 Thieving for 30 minutes: cast it, then pick the lock.
